title: Mainworld
description: Mainworld... mod introduces several new mechanics,items,and armor. it also adds about 30 diffferent structures,each suited to its own biome,as well as new biomes. Explore the world and discover its fill potential, know that they are always watching...
body: Mainworld... is a mod that adds weapons and armor, new ores, several game mechanics, and new blocks that can be used in different ways, such as traps, redstone mechanisms, and more. It also adds hardcore elements to your world, such as new biomes and their entities, unexpected monster attacks on the player, new structures that are more challenging than usual, new bosses, and effects. The mod combines vanilla and fantasy elements, allowing you to explore the world and discover its potential. However, be cautious, as there is much more to this world than meets the eye. Download the mod if you want: adventure, hardcore (try it with your friends)
